baseline.fixtureIdentityPolicy: Fixture text, Grain document IDs, and Grain allocation IDs are derived from this seed. Yjs client IDs are generated by Yjs and are reported as observed values.

historicalResults.label: historical, not a current result
historicalResults.source: PR #43 report as cited by the authoritative grain/52 proposal
historicalResults.limits: Separate medians are not an end-to-end median. The heap figure does not isolate listener cost.

core.description: Canonical acceptance, projection, serialization, checkpoint export, and native operation counts. The wide-list shape includes one untimed structural move counter sample.

editor.description: Mounted Chromium canonical editor input and projection at 150 paragraphs.
editor.timedStage: Chromium keyboard input through canonical acceptance, rendering, and settled browser projection

harness.description: Mounted Chromium demo harness input including canonical change handling, Markdown serialization, JSON serialization, parser rebuild, and render scheduling.
harness.timedStage: Chromium keyboard input through full harness update and settled projection

retention.description: Native history callback and state growth at 0, 64, and 500 retained groups, plus a 10000-action trace.

ablationTargets.observable: Y.Map assignments by root/type/key and same-value revision assignments
accepted update bytes, complete delete-set ranges, transaction update bytes, checkpoint bytes
full harness input latency compared with the mounted editor and core acceptance profiles
prepare/apply timing, public Y.Doc.transact calls, introduced client IDs, structures, and heap
active afterTransaction callbacks, retained native structures, checkpoint bytes, and heap
wide-list structural map writes, receipt bytes, and checkpoint bytes

engineeringTargets.classification: Budgets and hard invariants, not measured results.
engineeringTargets.routineLocalInput: Zero full-document clones, state encodes, full-registry drafts, or full-document reparses.
engineeringTargets.metadataAndUpdates: Write changed tape revisions only; authored action deltas do not export historical deletions.
engineeringTargets.historyCapture: One dispatcher; at most one native group handler per matching text transaction.
engineeringTargets.authorIdentity: Stable per live document/session, not per keystroke.
engineeringTargets.childReferences: Native writes and receipt payload scale with changed references, not unchanged siblings.
engineeringTargets.storage: Report raw growth per trace and after history eviction; attribute growth rather than claiming an arbitrary percentage.
engineeringTargets.retention: Bound response payloads and define explicit epoch rebuild for long-lived native state.

measurementRules.percentiles: Nearest-rank p50 and p95 over measured operations. Each process reports mean and population standard deviation. The runner reports median and median absolute deviation across fresh-process p50 values, plus p95 of those process p50 values.
measurementRules.freshProcesses: Each run starts a new npm/Vitest process. Do not run profiles concurrently on a shared performance worker.
measurementRules.memory: Report heap and RSS separately. Forced-GC availability and whether samples were collected after GC are included in output.
measurementRules.bytes: Native transaction update bytes, accepted action envelope bytes, complete delete-set range counts, and encoded checkpoint bytes are distinct measurements.
measurementRules.hardware: Timing results are observations for the recorded environment, not budgets or portable performance claims.
